newsitem.title: CHINA: China holds border forces talks with Russia.
newsitem.headline: China holds border forces talks with Russia.

text.p: China, Russia and three central Asian nations have concluded two weeks of talks in Beijing on reducing military forces along their common borders and said they made progress, the Xinhua news agency said on Tuesday.

The negotiations were the 20th round of such talks among diplomats and military officials from China, Russia and the three former Soviet republics of Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan and Tajikistan, the agency said.

"The two delegations exchanged views on certain issues in (a) friendly and fact-seeking atmosphere, and they reached new progress on the negotiations," Xinhua said, but gave no details of the progress.
The talks between a Chinese group and a delegation of the other four nations headed by Russia had focused on cutting troops along the border with China and concluded on Monday, Xinhua said.
A Russian diplomat in Beijing confirmed the talks had taken place and said another round would be held on October 24 in Moscow. The official declined to give further details.
The five nations last April signed a goodwill treaty aimed at limiting troop movements along their 7,640 km (4,580 miles) of border.
